Name: bugboy's wizard sprites for RRRR (and buggy seasonals)
Author: bugboydarklord
Description:
HELLO IM BACK-ish. Not much of a mod today but ever since my tastes have changed I've been looking for a very specific iteration of the wizard. I couldn't find him. Thus, I did it myself. I really contemplated posting this since I know it's somewhat broken (in the seasonals side) but hey! One man's trash is another man's treasure. 

In the normal file, find the base portraits and sprites... but in the EXTRA file, find seasonal outfits and alternate hairstyles, following the RRRR companion mod.

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/size]
FOR NO SEASONALS: (recommended version)

Sprites:
- In the folder titled "Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp" drag and drop it into your files. Do not open it, just drag and drop... Afterwards, when prompted to replace files, click yes.
- If that doesn't work, manually copy-paste the images in the "Characters" folder within "assets"

Portraits:
- Drop the Wizard.png into your main portrature file. 

FOR SEASONALS: 

- Drag and drop into your mods file.

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2055798]Jellonip[/url]'s RRRR mod
Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT) -- For seasonals!
